title: Scraping Engineer
raw_posting_text:
ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be an embedded member of a fast-growing AI startup team, owning the reliability and quality of a web extraction infrastructure that processes millions of pages daily through hundreds of scripts. Reporting to a Forward Deployed Engineer, this role is critical to keeping a high-throughput data pipeline running smoothly and accurately.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Monitor and triage a queue of broken scrapers and data quality alerts to keep operations running without interruption.

 - Build and deploy new web scraping scripts for websites that need to be added to the extraction pipeline.

 - Validate scraped data for accuracy and investigate any discrepancies that surface.

 - Create dashboards to visualize and monitor scraped data in real time.

 - Collaborate with AI agents to fill capability gaps, fix issues, and improve existing scripts.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 1+ years of hands-on, professional experience building or maintaining web scraping solutions.

 - Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for building and debugging scraping scripts.

 - Solid SQL skills for data querying and validation.

 - Experience with Puppeteer or similar browser automation libraries.

 - Experience debugging and fixing broken scrapers in production environments.

 - Familiarity with message queues such as RabbitMQ and in-memory caching systems such as Redis.

 - Experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent cloud infrastructure, including data warehouse tools like BigQuery.

 - Comfort with bash scripting and git version control.

 - Experience validating data quality and accuracy in extracted datasets.

 - Experience building dashboards or data visualization tools is a plus.

 - Strong async communicator who sends proactive updates and flags blockers early.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and able to scope project timelines independently in a fast-paced startup setting.


LOCATION

Fully remote, open to any time zone. You will need 8+ hours of daily availability with overlap during US business hours. Visa sponsorship is not available.
notes: PLACEHOLDER LABEL. The text says 'Visa sponsorship is not available', so the signal is no_sponsorship rather than unclear. A US role with no sponsorship is blocked for this candidate whatever else it offers, and the prompt says a blocked posting scores below 10 regardless of fit - which is the rule this example exists to check. It would otherwise be a near match: SQL, pipelines, data quality.

title: Founding Engineer
raw_posting_text:
ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a founding engineering role at a seed-stage data infrastructure company, working directly with the CTO to build core systems for extracting, analyzing, and visualizing web data at scale. You will own large, meaningful pieces of the product, from autonomous agents to distributed backend services, powering enterprise customers who depend on reliable, structured web data every day.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build autonomous agents that solve real-world information extraction problems across diverse and unpredictable web environments.

 - Design and iterate on a full-stack, self-serve application that makes complex workflows intuitive for non-technical users.

 - Maintain and scale backend architecture to reliably process thousands of requests per second and handle tens of millions of rows of data daily.

 - Contribute across the entire stack, including infrastructure as code, ML pipelines, and whatever else the team needs to move fast.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience shipping production software, or equivalent demonstrated skill in a 0-to-1 environment.

 - Proven track record launching products in small, early-stage teams with rapid iteration cycles.

 - Hands-on experience building LLM applications and agentic systems, including RAG, model evaluation, and fine-tuning.

 - Full-stack capability spanning backend, frontend, infrastructure, and AI agents.

 - Experience designing and maintaining high-scale distributed systems handling thousands of requests per second.

 - Proficiency with infrastructure as code and deployment automation.

 - Domain expertise in antibot systems, reverse engineering, JavaScript deobfuscation, or browser automation is a strong plus.

 - Experience with web scraping, data extraction, or web automation at scale is a strong plus.

 - Strong bias toward action and genuine excitement about the pace and autonomy of early-stage startups.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary range: $170,000 to $220,000 USD annually, plus equity. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in New York City, NY. Candidates must be based in or willing to relocate to New York City to work in person with the team.
notes: PLACEHOLDER LABEL. The text says 'Visa sponsorship is available', so the signal is sponsors and eligibility is eligible. The interesting part is the score: sponsorship is no reason to rate it highly. It asks for 5+ years and a founding-engineer track record, so it is a poor use of a student's application time. This example catches a prompt that conflates 'can apply' with 'worth applying'.

title: Supply Chain Automation Intern

We are looking for associates who will take on our customers’ challenges with passion and persistence until the right solution is found and who will thrive in a face-paced, collaborative and exciting environment. Why work with Bosch Rexroth? Challenging Projects : We are driven by innovation and being at the cutting edge of everything that we do. At Bosch Rexroth every day is different and your time will be filled with interesting and exciting projects. Amazing Colleagues:  Our people make us who we are, and we are very proud of our diverse and skilled global team. Having a supportive and encouraging team around you can make all the difference. Learning and Development:  We want you to reach your fullest potential, for both yourself and for Bosch Rexroth. That’s why we actively promote growth and development. Change the World:  We want to give you the opportunity to not only drive your career forward but also to change the world. The work we do at Bosch Rexroth can make a big difference to the world around you. Social & Value-Driven:  We have a tradition of assuming social responsibility in all that we do. Our success, and our roadmap for the  future, is based on our lived values. This covers everything, from community to the environment, to being a social employer. Flexibility & Freedom:  We strive to give you a balance between your work and home life, as well as the freedom to drive your career forward. International Opportunities:  We are a truly global, fully networked company, with locations in more than 80 countries all over the world. Key Responsibilities Analyze backlog reports and initiate proactive communication with vendors to expedite product procurement Maintain and monitor expedite communication; provide responses within 24/48h Entry, confirmation, and management of purchase orders    Execute material planning processes; monitor stock levels Identify bottlenecks in daily operations Design, prototype, and build automated workflows to streamline order management and vendor communications Graduate ( graduated within the last 6 months ) or currently enrolled in a diploma/degree program in Supply Chain Management, Business Analytics, Management Information Systems (MIS), or a related field of study. Strong interest in business process automation (e.g., RPA, Power Automate, VBA/Macros, Python, or SQL) Basic knowledge of SAP is an asset Analytical mindset with a passion for transforming manual workflows into scalable, automated processes Excellent communication skills for cross-functional collaboration
notes: PLACEHOLDER LABEL. A CANADIAN posting, and the candidate is a Canadian citizen, so work authorisation is simply not a question: eligibility must be eligible and must never be blocked for needing sponsorship. This is the single most important rule in the prompt and the one most likely to break when it is edited. The text never mentions sponsorship, so the signal is unclear. An internship in the right country, but supply-chain automation rather than data work, hence a middling score.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with Operations, Science, and Finance teams to…
notes: PLACEHOLDER LABEL. The aggregator truncates descriptions at 500 characters, so the work-authorisation boilerplate that would normally sit at the end is missing entirely - this example exists to check the prompt keeps saying 'unclear' instead of inventing a requirement it cannot see. Good domain match (data, analytics, internship) but the term is Summer 2027 and the candidate needs Winter 2027, which should hold the score down. FIRST RUN DISAGREED: the model answered 'eligible', reasoning that Lyft routinely sponsors J-1 visas for student interns - which the prompt explicitly permits, since eligibility may draw on knowledge about the employer. This label is probably the weaker of the two and is left unchanged for you to decide; flipping a label to match the model is how a golden set stops being ground truth.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
raw_posting_text: The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team can provide you with the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive scale, integrated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant cloud environment. OCI is committed to providing the best in cloud products that meet the needs of our customers who are tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges. The Virtual Networking team within OCI delivers Network-as-a-Service that handles planning, provisioning, life cycle management and security of our customers' network infrastructure. This is an opportunity to be a part of a team that is bootstrapping a brand new OCI service and build innovative solutions for our customers from the ground up. We are looking for hands-on engineers with expertise and passion in solving difficult problems related to high-availability and scalability in service-oriented architecture. These are exciting times, and our team is growing fast, working on ambitious new initiatives. An engineer at any level can have significant technical and business impact. We are looking for adaptable, self-motivated engineers with ability to learn quickly.
notes: PLACEHOLDER LABEL. Silent on sponsorship, so unclear on both counts - Oracle does sponsor, but the text does not say so and the signal reports only the text. Principal level, so it should score near zero for a student even though the technology is a good match. The floor case: if this scores highly, seniority handling has broken.
